Minecraft Bedrock.description:
Minecraft Bedrock Edition dedicated server (Windows, mobile, and console clients). The server updates to the latest Bedrock release on every Rock-on start.

Note: uses `net=host` for core functionality.

Based on a custom OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 (via Box64 emulation) architecture.
Minecraft Bedrock.more_info:
Network

Clients connect on TCP port 19132, then each player uses a UDP port in the range 19140-19155. Allow both on any firewall, and forward both for access from outside your network. UDP 7551 is used for LAN discovery.

Allowlist

The allowlist is off, so any player who can reach the server can join. To restrict access, edit allowlist.json and server.properties (allow-list=true) in the data Share and restart the Rock-on.

Administration

Send console commands with `docker exec minecraft-bedrock send-command help`; output appears in `docker logs minecraft-bedrock`.
